note: Every sample that draws one writes `widget.GRADKIENT_POLYLINE`, and the watchface reference spells it that way too. This page is the only place the name appears without the `K`. Passing the documented spelling to `createWidget` is very likely to yield `undefined`.
Sample code creates this widget as `hmUI.widget.WIDGET_DELEGATE`, not `DELEGATE`. The page title is the shorter name and the code in its own example is the longer one, so the page contradicts itself.
